text:
Jorge (sales): Kicked off Pacific Bank POC with legal today. They want a 6-week trial starting 4/6. Need owners for integrations + infra. Top priorities: SSO (SAML), VPC private deployment, perf targets. Any blockers?
Devin K: I can own model integration + API contract. Need confirm on model variant — customer willing to use open model?
Jorge (sales): Yes, they prefer open models; cost-sensitive. Also want embedding rerank for search. Seema please confirm infra options.
Seema R: We can offer Private (VPC) or Dedicated. VPC onboarding takes ~2 weeks if networking team is available. Need IP allowlist and SAML IdP metadata. Assigning network ticket.
Alex C: I'll take the API contract + client SDK tests. FYI: we currently support /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings endpoints. We should lock request/response schema.
Priya S: I'll own success criteria/evals. Proposed: 95th perc latency <200ms for generate (5k seq), embeddings cosine drift <0.02 vs baseline, 99.9% availability during demo. Thoughts?
Jorge (sales): Sounds good. Can we scope a lightweight end-to-end demo app by week 2? Customer wants Slack integration demo.
Devin K: Slack demo ok. Need webhook flow + token exchange; @Alex C can you add the OAuth route? Also pinging @Priya S for eval prompts.
Alex C: Yep, adding /oauth/callback and a quick example. Will PR Friday. Snippet:
```http
POST /oauth/callback
body: { code }
```
Seema R: Network note — we'll need a cross-account VPC peering, and KMS key access. I'll open infra ticket and sync with NetEng. ETA 10 business days.
Jorge (sales): Can someone own the customer checklist (SAML metadata, IPs, PO, contact)? otherwise I'll maintain it.
Priya S: I'll track checklist + test prompts. I'll also prepare a minimal eval harness to run daily against canary. Ping me for sample prompts.
Devin K: Quick CR ping — I have a model adapter change that affects embedding dims. @Alex C please review once I drop the PR (coming today).
Alex C: Will review. If embedding shape changes, update client SDK and docs. Reminder to include migration notes.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging -> canary at 2024-04-01T03:00Z. (reaction :rocket:)
Jorge (sales): Ok team, owners: Integration = Devin, API/SDK = Alex, Infra/VPC = Seema, Evals/success = Priya. I'll be main sales contact to customer (Jorge). I'll email them the timeline and ask for SAML metadata. Back to you all for blockers.
Seema R: No blockers from infra yet beyond network lead availability. I'll post ticket #NET-412 when created.
Priya S: Added initial eval set to the shared drive: https://drive.company/pacific-evals (reaction :white_check_mark:).
Devin K: PR: https://git.company/pulls/5421 — tagging @Alex C for review. Also note model variant is 'open-7b-quant'.
Alex C: Reviewed, left minor nits. Expect approve tomorrow.
Jorge (sales): Thanks. I'll reconvene async on Friday sync thread. If anyone needs a quick call, drop availability here.
